validation_context: Existing 5-fold prompt-grouped OOF score banks; this is a diagnostic blend probe, not a fully nested outer/inner experiment.

direct_same_oof_scan.warning: The best weight is selected on the same pooled OOF rows and is selection-biased.
direct_same_oof_scan.best_transform: raw or row_softmax (tie at displayed precision)

fold_held_out_weight_probe.warning: For each held-out GroupKFold fold, the weight is selected from the other OOF rows. This is more conservative than the direct scan but is not a complete nested retraining experiment because the existing OOF models may have seen the held-out outer fold while producing predictions for the selection rows.

candidate_submission.recommendation: Use only as a second CPU Kaggle experiment after submitting the plain style-aware four-view baseline; do not claim the diagnostic BA as a leaderboard guarantee.
